text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock E at a profit felt rewarding, but repeated partial sales should follow a portfolio plan rather than the satisfaction of locking in gains.","After buying the four other stocks, I should judge the whole portfolio’s diversification and risk—not react to a small monthly dip or rebound.","Because I check my account infrequently and rarely trade, I’ll set clear long-term rules and trade only when they change my portfolio for a good reason."]}
